name: Qatar Insurance Company Q.S.P.C.
summary: Qatar Insurance Company Q.S.P.C., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the insurance, reinsurance, real estate asset management, and information technology businesses. It operates in six segments: Marine & Aviation Insurance, Property & Casualty Insurance, Health & Life Insurance, Real Estate, Advisory, and Investments. It offers personal insurance products, including personal, car, travel, mandatory visitors, home, motorcycle, and boat insurance. The company also offers property and commercial, marine and aviation, energy, and motor fleet. It is involved in real estate activities; issuance of tier 2 notes; and provision of IT and related, advisory, and investment management services. …
